summary: Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter
description: The bug Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter. How to reproduce - Execute the command: /give @s jigsaw - Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface) - Type in any of the text boxes, characters: or {} (invalid unicode characters blocking the "done" button) - Press the enter key The game crashes Crash report 1.14.3-pre3 : [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt] Description: keyPressed event handler n: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: minecraft:empty at qt. (SourceFile:38) at qt. (SourceFile:43) at dbo.d(SourceFile:44) at dbo.b(SourceFile:35) at dbo.keyPressed(SourceFile:106) at cvm.a(SourceFile:410) at cvm$$Lambda$3043/1332786777.run(Unknown Source) at czx.wrapScreenError(SourceFile:441) at cvm.a(SourceFile:408) at cvm$$Lambda$1477/601932288.invoke(Unknown Source) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWKeyCallbackI.callback(GLFWKeyCallbackI.java:37) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwPollEvents(GLFW.java:3101) at cuh.l(SourceFile:425) at cuh.c(SourceFile:283) at cvo.b(SourceFile:1023) at cvo.e(SourceFile:976) at cvo.b(SourceFile:411) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:154)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Execute the command: `/give @s jigsaw`
2. Place the jigsaw block in your world.
3. Right-click on the placed jigsaw block to open its user interface.
4. Type any of the invalid characters `or {}` into one of the text boxes.
5. Press the Enter key.
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14.2, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.3
Observed Behavior:
When invalid characters are entered into the text boxes of a jigsaw block's user interface and the enter key is pressed, the game crashes. To reproduce this issue, first execute the command `/give @s jigsaw` to obtain a jigsaw block. Place the jigsaw block and open its user interface. In any of the text fields within the interface, input invalid Unicode characters such as "{" or "}". These characters will prevent the "done" button from being activated. Upon pressing the enter key, the game crashes. This behavior was observed in version 1.14.3-pre3, and a crash report is available at [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt]. The error message from the crash indicates an issue with non-standard characters in the path of location "minecraft:empty," specifically within the keyPressed event handler.

This detailed description should provide developers with a clear understanding of the bug, including specific steps to reproduce it and relevant information about the crash report.
Expected Behavior: When invalid characters such as `{}` are entered into the jigsaw block's text boxes and the enter key is pressed, the game should not crash. Instead, it should display an error message indicating that the input contains invalid characters and prevent further submission until valid input is provided. The game should remain stable and functional after attempting to submit invalid input.
